description: Project scaffold under uv plus the core leaf modules with no inter-source coupling: pyproject.toml (+ committed uv.lock), the hotline package skeleton with the shared Item dataclass, config loading, the detection ruleset, and the sqlite dedupe store, each with unit tests. Independent of FEAT-002/003 except as their foundation; must be done first because everything imports these types and uv.lock is the environment all later features build/test in.
steps: Create pyproject.toml: [project] name='hotline', version, description, readme='README.md', requires-python='>=3.13', license MIT. [project.optional-dependencies] audio=['faster-whisper'], dev=['pytest','ruff']. [project.scripts] hotline='hotline.cli:main'. [build-system] setuptools with package discovery for the 'hotline' package (include hotline.sources). [tool.ruff] line-length=100, lint.select=['E','F','I','UP','B']. [tool.pytest.ini_options] testpaths=['tests'].
Run `uv venv` then `uv sync` (core+dev) to create .venv, then `uv lock` to generate uv.lock; commit uv.lock. (Use `uv sync --extra audio` only if validating the audio extra; CI does not need it.)
Create hotline/__init__.py with a package docstring and __version__='0.1.0'.

Create hotline/__main__.py: `from hotline.cli import main` then `raise SystemExit(main())` under `if __name__ == '__main__':`. (cli.main arrives in FEAT-003; keep the import at module top so `python -m hotline` resolves once cli.py exists. To keep FEAT-001 buildable on its own, this import is only exercised at runtime, not import-time of other modules.)
Create hotline/sources/__init__.py defining `@dataclass(frozen=True) class Item` with fields title:str, url:str, text:str, published:str|None, source:str, plus module and class docstrings.

Create hotline/config.py: `@dataclass class Config` with fields contest_urls:list[str], feed_url:str|None, poll_interval:int=45, user_agent:str (polite default like 'hotline/0.1 (+contact)'), audio_stream_url:str|None, audio_enabled:bool=False, x_bearer:str|None, ig_token:str|None, telegram_token:str|None, chat_id:str|None. Implement `load_config(path: str | Path | None = None, env: Mapping[str,str] | None = None) -> Config` that reads TOML via tomllib (default 'config.toml'; missing file => all defaults), maps [source]/[audio]/[poll] style tables into fields, and overlays secrets ONLY from env (HOTLINE_TELEGRAM_TOKEN, HOTLINE_CHAT_ID, HOTLINE_X_BEARER, HOTLINE_IG_TOKEN); never read secrets from TOML. env defaults to os.environ but is injectable.

Create hotline/detect.py: `@dataclass(frozen=True) class Detection` (text:str, score:float, matched_terms:list[str], source:str). Define the positive-term weight table and negation terms per plan.md scoring section. `score_text(text: str) -> tuple[float, list[str]]`: case-insensitive, phrases matched as contiguous substrings; sum weights of matched terms, normalize `min(1.0, raw/6.0)`; if any negation term ('closed','no longer','ended') present, return (0.0, []). `detect(text: str, source: str, threshold: float = 0.5) -> Detection | None` returns None below threshold. Module docstring documents the scoring.

Create hotline/store.py: `class Store` opened on a db path (supports ':memory:'), creating the schema on init (table seen_items(hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, first_seen REAL, notified INTEGER DEFAULT 0) + index on first_seen). Methods: static/standalone `item_hash(item) -> str` (sha256 of normalized title+url+text where normalize = strip().lower() with collapsed whitespace), `seen(hash) -> bool`, `record(hash)` (insert first_seen=now if absent), `mark_notified(hash)`, `should_notify(item_or_hash) -> bool` (True if hash absent, or present with notified=0 and not older than 7 days), `prune(now: float | None = None)` deletes rows with first_seen < now-604800. Allow an injectable clock for testability.

Create tests/__init__.py and tests/conftest.py with: `fixtures_dir()` returning the repo fixtures path, `read_fixture(name)` reader, and fake-factory helpers (will be extended in later FEATs). Create tests/test_config.py, tests/test_detect.py, tests/test_store.py covering the cases in plan.md 'Test cases'. No network.
Run the uv verification commands below and ensure clean.
acceptance_criteria: `uv run pytest tests/test_config.py tests/test_detect.py tests/test_store.py` passes all tests.
`uv run ruff check .` and `uv run ruff format --check .` report no issues.
uv.lock exists and is committed; `uv lock --check` (or re-running `uv lock`) shows it is in sync with pyproject.toml.
`python3 -c "from hotline.sources import Item; from hotline.config import load_config; from hotline.detect import detect; from hotline.store import Store"` imports without error.
detect('call now, first caller wins tickets','web') returns a Detection with score>=0.5; detect on text containing 'closed' returns None (negation).
A Store on ':memory:' records a hash, reports should_notify False after mark_notified, and prune() removes a back-dated entry.
verification: uv run pytest tests/test_config.py tests/test_detect.py tests/test_store.py
findings:
Scaffold + core leaf modules landed; 19 tests pass, ruff check/format clean, uv.lock committed and in sync (31 packages).

APIs for later features to import:
- hotline.sources.Item: frozen dataclass(title:str, url:str, text:str, published:str|None, source:str). Positional construction used in tests: Item('t','u','x',None,'web').
- hotline.config.Config: dataclass with fields contest_urls:list[str] (default []), feed_url:str|None, poll_interval:int=45, user_agent:str='hotline/0.1 (+contact)', audio_stream_url:str|None, audio_enabled:bool=False, x_bearer:str|None, ig_token:str|None, telegram_token:str|None, chat_id:str|None. load_config(path:str|Path|None=None, env:Mapping[str,str]|None=None)->Config. TOML tables consumed: [source].contest_urls/[source].feed_url/[source].user_agent, [poll].interval, [audio].enabled/[audio].stream_url. Secrets ONLY from env: HOTLINE_TELEGRAM_TOKEN, HOTLINE_CHAT_ID, HOTLINE_X_BEARER, HOTLINE_IG_TOKEN. Module constants exported: DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH='config.toml', DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL=45.
- hotline.detect.Detection: frozen dataclass(text:str, score:float, matched_terms:list[str], source:str). score_text(text)->tuple[float,list[str]]; detect(text, source, threshold:float=0.5)->Detection|None. SCORE NORMALIZATION CONSTANT: SCORE_CAP=6.0 (score = min(1.0, raw/6.0)). DEFAULT_THRESHOLD=0.5. TERM_WEIGHTS dict (iteration/match order = call now:3, first caller:3, phone lines:2, call in:2, text in:2, giveaway:2, contest:2, whatsapp:1, win:1, tickets:1); matched_terms preserves this dict order, NOT text order. NEGATION_TERMS=('closed','no longer','ended') force (0.0, []). Phrases matched as contiguous substrings (case-insensitive). Note: 'call now' alone scores exactly 0.5 and passes threshold (>=).
- hotline.store.Store(db_path:str, now:Callable[[],float]=time.time). Methods: seen(hash)->bool, record(hash), mark_notified(hash) (records first if unseen), should_notify(item_or_hash: Item|str)->bool (True if absent, or notified=0 and first_seen within 7 days), prune(now:float|None=None)->int (returns rows deleted), close(). Standalone function hotline.store.item_hash(item)->str = sha256 over normalized_title+'\n'+raw_url+'\n'+normalized_text; normalize=strip().lower() with collapsed whitespace (URL is NOT normalized). Module constant TTL_SECONDS=604800. Schema table seen_items(hash TEXT PK, first_seen REAL, notified INTEGER DEFAULT 0) + idx_seen_items_first_seen.

Deviations/notes:
- pyproject [project.optional-dependencies] dev=['pytest','ruff'] is an EXTRA, not a uv dependency-group. Plain `uv sync` installs core only; verification/CI must run `uv sync --extra dev` (or `--extra audio` for audio) to get ruff/pytest. uv.lock already includes these; installing the extra does not change the lock.
- hotline/__main__.py imports hotline.cli.main at module top (cli.py arrives in FEAT-003); `python -m hotline` will fail until cli.py exists, but all FEAT-001 modules import cleanly.
- Local interpreter is CPython 3.14.7 (requires-python>=3.13 honored); avoid 3.14-only syntax.
- tests/conftest.py exposes fixtures `fixtures_dir` (Path) and `read_fixture` (name->text reader) for later FEATs; fixtures/ dir does not exist yet (created in FEAT with web/audio).
